_comment: A1 interface-cross-attention head for Ankh v1 Large (ElnaggarLab/ankh-large, tag 'ankh', the MuLAN-paper REFERENCE model). Geometry is identical to lightatt_a1_ankh3_large.json because ankh-large and ankh3-large share xattn_dim=1536; this file exists so the v1 reference arm is configured under an honest name rather than borrowing the ankh3 config. See experiments/ANKH_PROVENANCE_AUDIT.md.
